question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**suspected**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the actions that might have been taken in a particular context, likely involving legal or financial activities.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate something that can be done to the subjects in the context of the passage.
 
• "**Suspected**" fits well as it implies that there was some uncertainty or suspicion involved, which aligns with the context.
 
• Other options ("**smuggled**", "**filed**", "**debited**") do not fit as well in the context of suspicion or uncertainty.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Smuggled (तस्करी करना): "Smuggled" means to move goods illegally, which does not fit the context of suspicion or investigation.
 
• Filed (दर्ज करना): "Filed" means to submit documents, which does not align with the idea of suspicion or uncertainty.
 
• Debited (डेबिट करना): "Debited" means to charge an account, which is related to financial transactions but does not fit as well in the context of suspicion.
